lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso; spacing is highest in density at the anterior shoulder region and increases in interval width toward the posterior.

lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 4th, 6th, and 7th lines from the posterior terminate abruptly at the mid-torso line. Several fragmented white segments are visible near the lower ventral margin of the flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron pattern on the nasal bridge, two distinct white spots on the lower cheek, and a prominent white patch on the lower throat.
